image_prompts: A metal door with a 'push' sign above a horizontal bar

words.usage: v. (过去式 pushed, 过去分词 pushed); n.

image_prompts: Two speech bubbles with text floating above a park bench, bright colors
A group of colorful text message icons arranged in a circle, digital communication
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting conversation and digital messaging.

words.meaning_cn: 聊天，闲谈 v.；聊天 n.
words.usage: v. (过去式 chatted, 过去分词 chatted); n.

socratic_questions.question: 如果你和朋友轻松愉快地谈论一些事情，你会做什么？

A group of colorful tents pitched in a forest clearing, backpacks nearby

socratic_questions.question: 如果学校组织大家去公园玩一天，这属于什么活动？

image_prompts: A picnic basket on a checkered blanket in a sunny meadow
A winding hiking trail through a lush green forest with sunlight filtering through the trees

examples.en: We will go on an outing to the park this weekend.

socratic_questions.question: 如果周末天气晴朗，你和家人可能会做什么？

image_prompts: A overflowing trash can gradually shrinking in size, disappearing waste
A bright arrow pointing downwards towards a smaller pile of coins

examples.en: We should reduce the amount of waste we produce every day.

examples.cn: 你可以通过定期锻炼来减轻压力。

socratic_questions.question: 如果想要让房间里的噪音变小，你会怎么做？

image_prompts: A pressure gauge with the needle pointing to the red zone, indicating high pressure
A tangled ball of yarn with multiple knots, representing mental strain

words.image_desc_cn: 代表压力和精神紧张的视觉效果。

examples.en: Exams always cause me a lot of stress before they start.
examples.cn: 考试开始前总是给我带来很多压力。

examples.cn: 我尽量不去担心我完全无法控制的事情。

socratic_questions.question: 当你有很多作业要做，时间又很紧的时候，你感觉怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉通常与焦虑和紧张有关。

She felt ___ before her important job interview.

image_prompts: A silhouette of a person in a tree pose against a sunset background.
A rolled-up yoga mat with a water bottle and a small towel on a wooden floor.
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations related to yoga practice and equipment.
words.image_desc_cn: 与瑜伽练习和设备相关的插图。
words.collocations: practice yoga, yoga class, yoga mat

examples.en: She does yoga every morning to stay healthy and flexible.
examples.cn: 她每天早上做瑜伽以保持健康和柔韧。

examples.cn: 我想参加社区中心的瑜伽课程。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想提高身体的柔韧性和平衡感，你会选择哪种运动？

sentences: She practices ___ to reduce stress and improve her flexibility.

image_prompts: A magnifying glass focusing on a small, unidentified flying object in the sky.
A child's building blocks scattered on the floor, forming various abstract geometric objects.

examples.cn: 昨晚天空中那个奇怪的物体移动得非常快。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你不同意某人的观点或计划，你会做什么？

image_prompts: A plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce and basil leaves, rustic setting
The Colosseum in Rome at sunset, dramatic lighting

words.meaning_cn: 意大利的；意大利语的；意大利人

words.collocations: Italian food, Italian art, Italian culture

examples.cn: 她喜欢意大利食物，尤其是意大利面和披萨。

examples.cn: 他正在学习意大利语，因为他想去意大利旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想学习一种浪漫的语言，并且对披萨和意大利面感兴趣，你会选择哪种语言？

She speaks ___ fluently after living in Rome for years.

image_prompts: A computer screen displaying lines of code with syntax highlighting.
A keyboard with multiple programming symbols highlighted in different colors.
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations related to coding and software development.
words.image_desc_cn: 与编码和软件开发相关的插图。
words.collocations: computer programmer, software programmer, experienced programmer

examples.en: My brother is a skilled programmer, and he loves his job.
examples.cn: 我的哥哥是一名技术娴熟的程序员，他热爱他的工作。

examples.cn: 公司需要一名程序员来开发一个新的移动应用程序。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的电脑出现问题，你需要找谁来修复或改进软件系统？

sentences: A good ___ should be able to solve problems creatively and efficiently.

image_prompts: A traffic light showing a green arrow, indicating permission to proceed
A sign that reads 'Permitted' above an entrance to a garden

words.image_desc_cn: 绿灯和“允许”标志。
words.collocations: allow sb. to do sth.; allow for

examples.en: My parents allow me to go to the school trip this time.
examples.cn: 这次我父母允许我去学校旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的父母说你可以参加聚会，他们做了什么？

image_prompts: A golden trophy on a polished wooden shelf, spotlight shining

words.image_desc_en: Images representing success and accomplishment.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表成功和成就的图片。
words.collocations: great achievement, personal achievement, academic achievement

examples.en: Finishing the project early was a great achievement for the team.
examples.cn: 提前完成项目对团队来说是一项伟大的成就。

examples.cn: 她的学业成绩非常出色，尤其是在理科科目方面。

image_prompts: A close-up of a shiny gold coin with intricate designs

words.image_desc_cn: 闪亮的硬币和硬币集合的插图。
words.usage: n. (复数 coins) 一种金属货币

examples.cn: 我在我祖父的旧盒子里发现了一枚稀有的硬币。

examples.cn: 她用一枚硬币来决定看哪部电影。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想在自动售货机上买饮料，你需要什么？

image_prompts: A collection of colorful postage stamps arranged on a table, magnifying glass nearby

words.image_desc_en: Images depicting postage stamps and a rubber stamp.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示邮票和图章的图片。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 stamped, 过去分词 stamped)
words.collocations: postage stamp, rubber stamp, stamp collection, stamp on

examples.cn: 我需要一张邮票来把这封信寄给我的朋友。

examples.cn: 老师检查完我们的作业后会盖章。

image_prompts: A bedroom decorated with posters of musical bands and sports teams, suggesting youthful interests

words.collocations: teenage years, teenage life, teenage dreams

examples.en: She is going through a difficult teenage phase right now.
examples.cn: 她现在正经历一个困难的青少年阶段。

examples.cn: 许多青少年学生每天放学后喜欢运动。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一个年龄段，这个年龄段的人通常在上中学，并且开始对未来有自己的想法。

image_prompts: A colorful postcard with a picture of the Eiffel Tower on a wooden table

examples.cn: 我从暑假旅行中给最好的朋友寄了一张明信片。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你去旅游，想给朋友分享当地的美景，你会选择什么卡片寄给他们？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种卡片通常印有风景图片，方便邮寄。

image_prompts: A teacup with steam rising, next to a book on a rainy day
A sign pointing towards a less crowded path in a forest
words.image_desc_en: A preference for something calmer or more desirable.
words.image_desc_cn: 倾向于更平静或更令人向往的事物。
words.collocations: rather than, would rather, rather good

examples.cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不想去参加聚会。

examples.cn: 这部电影相当长，但我非常喜欢。

socratic_questions.question: 如果让你在两个选项中选择一个，你更倾向于哪个？

image_prompts: A vintage rotary phone on a wooden table, warm lighting
A black and white photograph in an ornate frame, sepia tone
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting items or styles from a bygone era.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘过去时代的物品或风格的插图。
words.collocations: old-fashioned ideas, old-fashioned clothes, old-fashioned values

examples.en: That restaurant has an old-fashioned atmosphere, like stepping back in time.
examples.cn: 那家餐厅有种老式的氛围，就像回到了过去。

sentences: My grandma loves to listen to ___ music on her record player.

image_prompts: A passport with stamps from various countries, travel stickers on the cover
A world map with pins marking different countries, each pin a different color
words.image_desc_en: Passport with stamps and a world map with country pins.
words.image_desc_cn: 带有印章的护照和带有国家别针的世界地图。
words.collocations: foreign language, foreign country, foreign culture
words.preposition_combos: from a foreign country, in a foreign language

examples.en: She wants to study a foreign language like French or Spanish.
examples.cn: 她想学习一门外语，比如法语或西班牙语。

examples.en: Visiting a foreign country can broaden your understanding of the world.
examples.cn: 访问一个外国可以拓宽你对世界的理解。

sentences: He is interested in ___ cultures and learning about their traditions.

image_prompts: A fluffy white cloud shaped like a castle floating in a blue sky
A person sleeping soundly in bed, a comic-style thought bubble showing a tropical beach above their head
words.image_desc_en: A cloud castle; A person dreaming of a beach.
words.image_desc_cn: 云朵城堡；一个人梦见海滩。
words.collocations: dream of success, dream of traveling

examples.en: I often dream of traveling around the world someday.
examples.cn: 我经常梦想着有一天能环游世界。

examples.en: Many students dream of getting high scores on the exam.
examples.cn: 许多学生梦想在考试中取得高分。

socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示在睡眠中或清醒时想象美好的事物。

sentences: She often ___ becoming a famous scientist in the future.

image_prompts: A lightbulb appearing above a notepad with a pencil beside it
A hand pointing to a whiteboard with the word 'Ideas' written on it
words.image_desc_en: A lightbulb idea and a whiteboard with 'Ideas'.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个灯泡代表想法，一块写着“想法”的白板。
words.collocations: make a suggestion, accept a suggestion, follow a suggestion

examples.en: My friend gave a good suggestion for our English project topic.
examples.cn: 我的朋友为我们的英语项目主题提出了一个很好的建议。

examples.en: The teacher accepted my suggestion to have a class outing next week.

socratic_questions.question: 如果你对朋友的生日派对有什么好的想法，你会怎么表达？

words.image_desc_cn: 破碎的花瓶；泄气的热气球。

words.image_desc_cn: 灵感的视觉表现：突然出现的想法和创造性的动力。
words.collocations: draw inspiration from, find inspiration in, a source of inspiration

socratic_questions.question: 当你感到迷茫，需要新的想法时，你会从哪里寻找动力和创意？

sentences: The beautiful scenery provided ___ for her new painting series.

A closed iron gate with a 'No Entry' sign hanging on it, forbidding access

words.image_desc_cn: 一把尺子和一扇紧闭的门象征着规则和限制。
words.collocations: strict rules, strict parents, strict teacher

examples.en: My parents are very strict with me about my study time.

socratic_questions.question: 如果某项规定不允许任何例外，你会用哪个词来形容它？
